title: Ordering at a Hawker Centre
meta: B2 · 约 260 词 · 场景：熟食中心点鸡饭与打包

lines.en: Hi, boss. What would you like?
lines.zh: 老板，要什么？

lines.en: **Hi. One chicken rice, please. Can I have roasted instead of steamed?**
lines.zh: 你好，一份鸡饭。能要烧鸡，不要白斩鸡吗？

lines.en: Sure. Breast or thigh? Thigh is more tender.
lines.zh: 可以。要鸡胸还是鸡腿？鸡腿比较嫩。

lines.en: Thigh, please. And one more, a ==small portion== for my son, with no chilli.
lines.zh: 鸡腿。再来一份小份给我儿子，不要辣椒。

lines.en: Okay, one small, no chilli. Eating here or ==takeaway==?
lines.zh: 好，一份小的，不要辣。在这里吃还是打包？

lines.en: Eating here. We're at table forty-two, near the drinks stall.
lines.zh: 在这里吃。我们坐四十二号桌，饮料摊旁边。

lines.en: Okay, I'll bring it over. Want any extras? We have ==braised== egg and ==beansprouts==.
lines.zh: 好，我端过去。要加什么吗？有卤蛋和豆芽。

lines.en: One braised egg, please. And could you __put the sauce on the side__ for the small one?
lines.zh: 加一个卤蛋。小份的酱能另外放吗？

lines.en: No problem. That's eight fifty altogether.
lines.zh: 没问题。一共八块五。

lines.en: **Can I pay by PayNow?**
lines.zh: 可以用 PayNow 付吗？

lines.en: Sure, scan the code here. Just __show me the screen__ after.
lines.zh: 可以，扫这里的码。付完给我看一下屏幕。

scenes.heading: 2. A Mix-up and a Takeaway Order

lines.en: Hi, sorry, I ordered here a few minutes ago. I think the small portion came with chilli by mistake.
lines.zh: 你好，不好意思，我几分钟前在这里点的。小份那盘好像不小心放了辣椒。

lines.en: Oh, sorry about that. I'll make you a new one, no chilli this time.
lines.zh: 哦，不好意思。我给你重新做一份，这次不放辣。

lines.en: Thanks. And while I'm here, could I __order one to go__? My wife is working late.
lines.zh: 谢谢。顺便再打包一份可以吗？我太太加班晚回来。

lines.en: Sure. Same as yours?
lines.zh: 好。跟你的一样？

lines.en: Roasted chicken rice, but with less rice and more ==cucumber==. And please __pack the chilli separately__.
lines.zh: 烧鸡饭，饭少一点，黄瓜多一点。辣椒请另外装。

lines.en: Okay. For takeaway, there's a twenty cent charge for the ==container==. Is that alright?
lines.zh: 好。打包的话餐盒要收两毛钱，可以吗？

lines.en: That's fine. Could you also pack the soup? Make sure it's tied tight so it doesn't ==spill==.
lines.zh: 可以。汤也帮我装一下？绑紧一点，别洒了。

lines.en: Will do. Do you need any ==cutlery==?
lines.zh: 好的。要餐具吗？

lines.en: **No need, we have some at home. We're trying to use less plastic.**
lines.zh: 不用，家里有。我们在尽量少用塑料。

lines.en: Good on you. Here's the new plate for your boy. I'll call you when the takeaway's ready.
lines.zh: 真不错。这是给你儿子的新一份。打包的好了我叫你。

lines.en: Great, thanks for __sorting it out__ so quickly.
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢你这么快就弄好了。

gist.q: 「你」给自己和儿子各点了什么？
gist.a: 自己要烧鸡饭配鸡腿，加一个卤蛋；儿子要小份、不要辣椒，酱另外放。

gist.q: 儿子那份出了什么问题？摊主怎么处理？
gist.a: 不小心放了辣椒；摊主重新做了一份不辣的。

gist.q: 给太太打包时「你」提了哪些要求？
gist.a: 烧鸡饭，饭少黄瓜多，辣椒另装，汤要绑紧别洒；餐盒收两毛钱，不要餐具。

prompts.q: 你在咖啡摊想点一杯少糖的冰奶茶，和一杯给孩子的热美禄，还想要一个袋子提走。跟摊主说清楚。
prompts.ref: Hi, uncle. Can I have one iced milk tea, less sugar, and one hot Milo for my son? Not too hot, please, he's only four. Both to take away. Could you put them in a bag with a handle, so I can carry them? I'm also buying food from the next stall. Thanks.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，大叔。一杯少糖冰奶茶，再给我儿子一杯热美禄，别太烫，他才四岁。都打包。能用带提手的袋子装吗？方便我拎着，我还要去隔壁摊买吃的。谢谢。

prompts.q: 找不到座位，你看到一张桌子上放着纸巾包（有人占座）。礼貌地问旁边的人能不能拼桌。
prompts.ref: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here? I see the tissue packet, so I wasn't sure. If your friends are coming, no problem, we'll look somewhere else. But if there's space, would you mind if my son and I shared the table with you? We'll only be about fifteen minutes.
prompts.ref_zh: 不好意思，这里有人坐吗？我看到放着纸巾，所以不太确定。如果你朋友要来，没关系，我们去别处找。不过如果有空位，介意我和儿子跟你们拼个桌吗？我们大概只坐十五分钟。
